title: A tempo change, even mid-bar, keeps the beat and re-warps at the next bar line
description:
As a performer, I want Apricity to keep the beat when the DAW's tempo changes, even in the middle of a bar, so that I can ride the tempo and Apricity stays with me.

Spec file: `features/link/clock.feature`. The bridge behavior below is the plan from M0 (apricitus-7e32cb); if M0 decides otherwise, this story is updated before any code.

```gherkin
Feature: Tempo changes while following a beat clock

  Background:
    Given the click score
    And playback is following a clock at 120 BPM with a quantum of 4

  Scenario: Tempo change in the middle of a bar
    When the clock changes to 90 BPM at beat 2.5 of a bar
    Then every click still sounds on a whole beat of the clock within the tolerance
    And until the next bar line the arrangement plays slower to stay on the beat
    And from a bar line after the change the clips are warped for 90 BPM and sound at their scored pitch

  Scenario: A tempo ramp re-warps once it settles
    When the clock moves from 120 to 128 BPM in 16 small steps over two bars and then holds
    Then every click sounds on the beat within the tolerance throughout
    And the arrangement is re-warped once, after the tempo holds

  Scenario: Returning to an earlier tempo reuses what was rendered
    Given the clock went from 120 to 90 BPM and the 90 BPM arrangement landed
    When the clock returns to 120 BPM
    Then the 120 BPM arrangement lands at the next bar line
    And no event is rendered again

  Scenario: A re-pitched clip keeps its speed and pitch
    Given a track plays a clip with warp repitch
    When the clock changes to 90 BPM
    Then each of that track's notes starts on its beat at 90 BPM
    And plays at its scored speed and pitch

  Scenario: Positions written in seconds stay where the score put them in beats
    Given a track plays at "12.5s", which is beat 20.83 at the score's 100 BPM
    When the clock plays at 120 BPM
    Then that note starts at beat 20.83 of the score
```
